A '''shakudo leggings''' is the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]], made by smithing a [[Copper Leggings|copper leggings]] with [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo alloy]]. It gives 6 armor and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_leggings.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/shakudo/leggings</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 6 armor.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Cleanse|{{G|Cleanse}} Slowness]]
* [[Magic protection|{{G|Magic protection}} 8]]
* {{G|Half heart}} {{G|Cooldown}} Regeneration

Each worn piece with the shakudo regeneration intrinsic shortens the interval at which the wearer receives Regeneration I for 3 seconds: every 30 seconds with one piece, 26 with two, 22 with three and 18 with four.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/stopwatches.mcfunction}}</ref>

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Shakudo equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/copper_ingot_from_blasting_copper_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
A [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] of level 2 (Apprentice) buys it for one [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_leggings.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Armor durability and protection were made consistent across tiers (leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, hepatizon, steel < diamond, electrum < adamant). Added translation support for all armor and tools. Shakudo armor could not be crafted; this was fixed.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Shakudo was renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive: 3 gold and 6 copper ingots became 2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper. Buffed shakudo armor: added the regeneration ability and the per-piece bonus.}}
{{History line|1.12|Fixed severe multiplayer lag caused by shakudo armor.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. Shakudo intrinsics are now exclusive with the electrum and adamant intrinsics. Shakudo armor was nerfed.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
